newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Bank of Korea to absorb 900 bln won through RPs.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Korea to absorb 900 bln won through RPs.

text.p: The Bank of Korea said on Monday it had decided to absorb 900 billion won from commercial banks through seven-day repurchase agreements (RP).
"We have decided to soak up 900 billion won in circulation due to abundant liquidity in the money market following corporate tax returns," a central bank official told Reuters.
He said the action was unlikely to have an impact on banks, which are required to meet their reserve requirement deadline on Tuesday.
